Title: Public preview: JavaScript and page contracts in Azure Active Directory B2C policies

Body.Content:
Page contracts and JavaScript in custom policies is now in public preview for Azure Active Directory B2C (Azure AD B2C).

You can use a page contract to define a specific version of elements for Azure AD B2C to provide for your policies. Page contracts won't change, and you can create dependencies on them when you use JavaScript.

By defining a page contract version for all your content definitions, you enable JavaScript for the policy. To learn more about how this works, read about using custom policies. We've also included some tips and samples for using JavaScript with Azure AD B2C.

Send comments, concerns, or feedback to aadb2cpreview@microsoft.com.
